s: March 31, 2025 - "Let's Have Fun" is a science fiction short story by L. Sprague de Camp. It was first published in the magazine Science Fiction Quarterly for May, 1957. It first appeared in book form in the collection A Gun for Dinosaur and Other Imaginative Tales (Doubleday, 1963), and afterwards appeared in the anthology Rare Science Fiction (Belmont, 1963).
